groups.title: Authentication
groups.question: Explain how token-based authentication works in a Go API, from login to a protected request.

followUps.JWT Structure & Validation: What are the three parts of a JWT, and why must the server check the signature and algorithm on every request?
followUps.Storing Tokens & Refresh Patterns: Why pair a short-lived access token with a refresh token, and why is an HttpOnly cookie safer than localStorage?

groups.title: Middleware
groups.question: Explain how middleware wraps handlers in a Go API, and how you protect it from abuse.

followUps.Middleware Execution Order: Why must recovery middleware be the outermost layer?
followUps.Rate Limiting: How does a token bucket allow short bursts while still capping the average rate?

groups.title: Input Validation
groups.question: Explain how your API should check incoming data and report errors back to clients.

followUps.Validation with go-playground/validator: How do validate struct tags work, and why check input before any business logic?
followUps.Structured Error Responses: What belongs in a JSON error response, and what must never be leaked in it?

groups.title: CORS & Security Headers
groups.question: Explain how you control which websites can call your API, and how you keep its secrets safe.

followUps.CORS Configuration: Why can't you use a wildcard origin when the browser sends cookies or auth headers?
followUps.Secrets Management: A secret was committed and then deleted in the next commit. Why is it still exposed, and what should you do?
